about: Failure care (task 32): known failure signatures -> a class -> one action, plus the plain words every failure carries. Read only by kitchen/failure-policy.ps1. The first signature that matches wins; then the kind's class; anything else is the unknown class. Patterns are .NET regular expressions, matched case-insensitively ((?-i:...) for case-sensitive parts).

flaky.label: Flaky timing
flaky.next: The Yard tries it once more on fresh main; if it fails again, Retry or Close

conflict.label: Merge conflict
conflict.next: The Yard freshens it from main once; if it still conflicts, Retry or Close

stale.label: Stale base
stale.next: The Yard tries it once more on fresh main; if main moved too far, Close it and order it again

resting.label: Crews resting
resting.next: It waits for the usage window and goes on by itself; nothing to do

privacy.label: Privacy hold
privacy.next: Your call: sign it off for a cloud crew, or Close it

real.label: Real failure
real.next: Needs a look: See why has the detail, then Retry or Close

infra.label: Infrastructure
infra.next: It waits for GitHub, CI or the network and tries again by itself

stopped.label: Stopped
stopped.next: Retry puts it back in the queue; Close ends it

unknown.say: Something failed that the Yard does not recognise
unknown.next: Real failure, needs a look: See why has the detail, then Retry or Close

signatures.say: Main moved and its change conflicts with main
Its brief was written against files that changed on main since
signatures.match: stale base|written against|no longer applies|patch does not apply|patch failed

signatures.say: CI failed on its pull request
Checking main after the merge failed
A step refused to go on
It looks private, so it stays on this PC until you say
Every able crew was resting or at its usage cap
signatures.match: usage limit|usage cap|quota|rate.?limit|HTTP 429|\b429\b|too many requests|cook is resting|no cook was free|cloud hiccup|waited too long for a cook

signatures.say: GitHub, CI or the network did not answer
signatures.match: no CI check|CI has not started|CI still running|has not caught up|could not reach|unreachable|network|connection (reset|refused|closed|timed out|aborted)|stream was interrupted|could not resolve host|name resolution|ECONNRESET|ETIMEDOUT|socket hang up|TLS handshake|GitHub API|api\.github\.com|HTTP 5\d\d|\b50[234]\b|UNAVAILABLE|overloaded|Service Unavailable|Bad Gateway|no space left on device|not enough space on the disk

signatures.say: It timed out on something that usually passes

timeout.say: The step ran out of time

hung.say: The step went quiet and was stopped

crash.say: The worker stopped without an exit code

memcap.say: The step used more memory than it may

logflood.say: The step wrote more log than it may

taster.say: The check found its output wrong or the reviewer said no

hold.say: It looks private, so it stays on this PC until you say
